# Joaquin Leimeter

> Full stack developer building from interface to infrastructure. Specializes in React and Vue ecosystems, with growing focus on DevOps and AWS infrastructure.

Joaquin is a full stack developer based in Rosario / Santa Fe, Argentina, with experience across the full product lifecycle - discovery, design, implementation, release. He currently builds agent-based workflows at Radium Rocket and leads AI-adoption practices on client teams such as AlixPartners.
